steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Christians and Muslims both see marriage as important, but have different teachings about divorce. Understanding these differences — and the diversity WITHIN each tradition — is essential for GCSE RS. | RS Exam Tips — Marriage and Divorce: 1. For Marriage and Divorce questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of Marriage and Divorce to its real-world impact on believers and society | UK Context: In the UK, debates about often involve both religious and secular voices.
